name: Honduras

latest_census.notes: The XVII Censo de Poblacion y VI de Vivienda 2013 asked ethnic self-identification ('pueblo': Lenca, Miskito, Garifuna, Maya-Chorti, Tolupan, Pech, Tawahka, Nahua, negro de habla inglesa, other/none), as the 2001 census had; the packet's 7% indigenous / 2% Afro-descendant is from it. Honduran censuses do not ask religion -- the packet's Evangelical/Catholic split is a survey figure. Whether 2013 carried a language item beyond the ethnic question is not recalled, so language is null. A new census was planned for the mid-2020s; no results are recalled.

subnational_sources.title: Censo 2013 online REDATAM processor (INE Honduras): poblacion por pueblo de pertenencia (autoidentificacion etnica), by departamento and municipio
subnational_sources.evidence: INE disseminates the 2013 census through a REDATAM processor that cross-tabulates any variable by department and municipality; 18 departments and 298 municipios equal the packet's admin1 and admin2 counts exactly. REDATAM has no API and its export is a table at a time; the CELADE (ECLAC) REDATAM mirror may hold the same database.

subnational_sources.title: Censo 2013 -- Caracterizacion de la poblacion indigena y afrohondurena (INE thematic tables by departamento)
subnational_sources.evidence: INE issued thematic PDF products on the indigenous and Afro-Honduran population after 2013; recalled as departmental, not municipal.

subnational_sources.title: IPUMS International: Honduras 2001 census microdata sample (ethnic group)
subnational_sources.evidence: Registration required, sample, and a census older; fallback only.

tier_reason: A 2013 census count of ethnic self-identification exists at department (18 = admin1) and municipio (298 = admin2), but through INE's REDATAM table builder with no API; religion is not asked.
recommended_action: Open INE Honduras' REDATAM Censo 2013 processor and run 'pueblo de pertenencia' by municipio (298) and departamento (18); export as XLS/CSV. Watch homonymous municipio names across departments (La Union, San Andres, El Porvenir each occur in more than one department), so join on the INE department+municipio code, not the bare name. Declare religion not_collected ('Honduran censuses do not ask religion'); leave language null until the 2013 questionnaire is checked.
not_found: A machine-readable (CSV/XLSX) release of 2013 ethnicity by municipio outside REDATAM
summary: Honduras' 2013 census asked ethnic self-identification (indigenous and Afro-Honduran pueblos) and INE serves it through a REDATAM online processor at department (18 = admin1) and municipio (298 = admin2) level, so both boundary levels can be filled, but only through a table builder with no API, hence Tier B. Religion is not a census item and the national figure in the packet is a survey estimate, so religion should be declared not_collected. Language is left null pending a look at the questionnaire. Municipio names repeat across departments, so join on codes.
